note: City counter practice: how City staff apply the published lists at intake, as staff have stated it or as City review decisions show it. It is not code and not a published handout, and it can change. Confirm with the City before relying on it.

items.title: Landscape plan
items.covers: Landscape Plan, including the same-named Plan Sheet Matrix column and application exhibits.
items.timing: Needed only when a trigger stated here applies.
items.applies_when: Due for a major remodel (LBMC 25.05.040(B)(1)(a)); a new building subject to the (B)(2) ADU and new-primary-dwelling carve-out (B)(1)(b); an improvement over 15 feet high or a new upper level (B)(1)(c); or proposed landscaping modifications. A pool, ground-level lounge deck, patio cover or incidental lawn alone is not a trigger. For the first three triggers, an as-built landscape plan satisfies intake when no landscape work is proposed.

exceptions.when: A trigger above is established and the selected matrix cell is not blank.
exceptions.timing: Due at intake. The City returns an application that lacks it.
exceptions.detail: The plan is required at intake; it must meet the published content requirements and the as-built landscape allowance where applicable.

exceptions.when: A trigger is established but the selected matrix cell is blank.
exceptions.timing: The City decides case by case. Ask the City.
exceptions.raise_with_city: Does the ordinance or the blank Plan Sheet Matrix cell govern Landscape Plan intake for this scope?

items.title: Exterior lighting plan
items.covers: Exterior Lighting Plan, including the Lighting Plan matrix column.
items.timing: Needed only when a trigger stated here applies.
items.applies_when: Under LBMC 25.05.040(B)(1)(a)–(c): a major remodel; a new building subject to the (B)(2) ADU and new-primary-dwelling carve-out; or an improvement over 15 feet high or a new upper level.

exceptions.when: A trigger above is established and the selected matrix cell is not blank.
exceptions.timing: Due at intake. The City returns an application that lacks it.
exceptions.detail: The plan is required at intake; it must meet the published content requirements.

exceptions.when: A trigger is established but the selected matrix cell is blank, including Upper-Level Additions or >15 ft above grade.
exceptions.timing: The City decides case by case. Ask the City.
exceptions.raise_with_city: LBMC 25.05.040(B)(1)(c) requires an exterior lighting plan, but the matrix cell is blank. Which governs at intake?

items.title: Historic assessment
items.covers: The historic resource assessment (character-defining features; what is removed and retained).
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: The City initiates the historic assessment at the applicant's first resubmittal, because the design may change in response to first-round comments. Not a sufficiency item at intake.

exceptions.when: The proposed work is truly minor and akin to repair, maintenance, or in-kind replacement of a historic resource (the City's example: roof replacement). An addition, new floor area, or a new unit is NOT minor in-kind work.
exceptions.timing: The City decides case by case. Ask the City.
exceptions.raise_with_city: Minor in-kind work on a historic resource: the City initiates the historian's review at intake. Confirm the packet contains either (i) a deposit for a City-retained historic assessment, or (ii) the applicant's consultant assessment plus the peer-review deposit — and in either case an executed Advance Deposit and Reimbursement Agreement.

items.title: Colored elevations
items.covers: Colored elevations of all sides (Design Review application).
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: Colored elevations may be deferred to the applicant's resubmittal. The City does not treat them as an application-sufficiency issue.

items.title: Staking plan (story poles)
items.covers: The staking plan (story-pole layout, datum-referenced pole elevations, certification table).
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: The staking plan may be deferred — the City recognizes that project designs often change between first and second iterations.

items.title: Objective Design Standards checklists (Chapter 25.13 pathway)
items.covers: The completed Chapter 2 General Design Standards checklist and exactly one applicant-selected Chapter 3 Form Group checklist, with plan-sheet locators, for an elected Chapter 25.13 pathway.
items.timing: The City decides case by case. Ask the City.
items.applies_when: The applicant elects Chapter 25.13 for a new single-family or two-family primary dwelling, including SB 9.
items.practice: City document 26790 says both checklists belong in the application package, but the intake consequence has not been confirmed by staff.
items.raise_with_city: Confirm whether omission of either completed objective-design checklist is intake-blocking, and whether the City provides a separately fillable checklist instead of the pages in document 26790.
items.source: City of Laguna Beach Objective Design Standards for Single-Family and Two-Family Residential Development, City document 26790 (August 2026)

items.title: Public-hearing noticing (posting, mailing labels, mailed notices, affidavit)
items.covers: Public-hearing noticing, including property posting, listing-service payment, mailing labels, mailed notices, and affidavit of mailing.
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: Noticing is due before the City notices a hearing, not at zoning-plan-check intake.

items.title: Early neighbor communication (Design Review)
items.covers: Early Neighbor Communication materials, certified mailing list, outreach notice, and outreach report for a Design Review project.
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: Neighbor communication is due before hearing scheduling, not at zoning-plan-check intake.

items.title: Coastal Development Permit noticing
items.covers: CDP-specific noticing for a hearing, de minimis waiver notice, or minor-development notice under the Coastal Development Permit application.
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: CDP noticing is due when the City prepares the later notice.

items.title: Paint swatches at the site
items.covers: The two-foot-square exterior paint swatches installed at the project site before a Design Review hearing.
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: Paint swatches are a later pre-hearing site action, not an electronic zoning-plan-check intake item.

items.title: JADU deed restriction
items.covers: The recorded deed restriction required for a JADU that shares sanitation facilities.
items.timing: Not needed for the intake check. The City asks for it at a later step, stated below.
items.practice: The deed restriction must be recorded before building permit issuance, not at zoning plan check.

sheet_sufficiency.source: Planning Division staff guidance, September 2026; Planning Division staff guidance, May 2026

labelled_items.title: Digital site photos
labelled_items.exempt_when: The scope of work is minor exterior work. The City's example is a Design Review for a minor exterior alteration. New development, new floor area, a new unit, or a major remodel is NOT minor exterior work.
labelled_items.practice: At this scope the City does not require the direction label or the description.
